summary: All ten briefed clauses PASS by re-execution. The FR-05 comment-required rule (ratified 2026-08-26) is marked on the form BEFORE submit and a photo-only review is blocked client-side with an explanation and zero outbound requests; REVIEW_EXISTS/BOOKING_NOT_COMPLETED/VALIDATION_FAILED 409/422 refusals render real per-code copy into the assertive aria-live region; a sent message's 201 body renders immediately with no moderation state ever displayed (ADR-002), and 403 NOT_PARTICIPANT / 409 BOOKING_CANCELLED map to typed human messages on both the load and send paths; the safety alert demands an explicit kit-Dialog confirmation (open and cancel provably send nothing), reports the truthful three-part FR-07 outcome, and the no-emergency-contact path is surfaced both before raising and in the outcome with /account links; the review success state states born-pending and never says published. Backend contracts the screens rely on were re-executed against this exact tree: TC-05, TC-06, TC-07, TC-08 and the wave-4 status suite all pass (5 suites / 60 tests). Community client specs: 3 files / 23 tests pass; eslint + prettier clean; npm run test:a11y exits 1 honestly with 7/7 NFR-07 interfaces present, all 11 static routes clean at wcag2a/wcag2aa, and the three community routes among the 6 parameterized routes that stay unaudited until wave-7 fixture ids. ONE low-severity confirmed finding (U6VC-F1): the live 401 code on every community endpoint is NO_SESSION, but the shared community error map only keys AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, so the actionable go-sign-in copy is unreachable and 401s fall back to the server's terse envelope message. One out-of-lane observation for U6V-BOOKING (client full-suite failure in BookingsListPage.test.jsx).

checks.subject: FR-05 — comment requirement marked BEFORE submit (ratified 2026-08-26, W4-F2)

Photos can never replace the comment.' — all rendered on first paint, before any submit. Re-executed: `npx vitest run src/features/community` → ReviewPage.test.jsx 'marks rating and comment required, blocks an empty submit with a focused summary, sends nothing' PASSES: both controls toBeRequired(), an empty submit renders the GDS ErrorSummary (role=alert) which TAKES FOCUS with one link per field (#review-rating, #review-comment), and fn.mock.calls proves the ONLY traffic was session hydration — no review POST left the browser.

checks.evidence: MessagesPage.jsx MESSAGE_OVERRIDES: NOT_PARTICIPANT → "Only this booking's guest or host can read or send messages in this conversation."; BOOKING_CANCELLED → 'This booking is cancelled, so its conversation is closed.'; load failures set the 'Conversation unavailable' error card (send form withheld), send failures render inline; both are announced assertively. findings.requirement: NFR-07 (error copy quality; build-plan G.2 render-a-real-message-per-code)
findings.summary: The live 401 code on every community endpoint is NO_SESSION, but the shared community map only keys AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, so the actionable sign-in copy is unreachable dead code.
findings.detail: src/modules/auth/middleware.js:34,39 — requireSession, the only auth gate on all five community-consumed routes, always overrides the AuthenticationError default with { code: 'NO_SESSION' }, and src/middleware/errorHandler.js:28 passes err.code through to the envelope verbatim. communityMessages.js BASE_MESSAGES keys 'AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED' (the src/lib/errors.js:55 default that requireSession never emits), so an anonymous or expired-session user on MessagesPage / ReviewPage / SafetyAlertPage falls through to the envelope-message fallback and sees the terse server text ('Authentication required' / 'Session is invalid or expired') instead of the map's actionable 'You need to sign in first. Go to the login page, sign in, then come back here.' NOT a G.2 violation outright — the fallback is still a human sentence, never a code or stringified body, and the 401 also flips the session store to anonymous via the http.js broadcast — but the copy the unit wrote for exactly this case can never render, and none of the three community specs exercises a 401, so the gap was invisible to the suite. The same latent NO_SESSION-vs-AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED assumption appears in the booking and account lanes (client/src/features/booking/components/bookingErrors.js:181, BookingsListPage.jsx:66, account/components/errorCopy.js:73, moderation/components/errorCopy.js:22) — flagged here for the coordinator since those files are outside this lane; the discovery lane's specs already use NO_SESSION correctly.
findings.suggestedFix: In communityMessages.js, key the sign-in copy under NO_SESSION (keeping AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED as an alias is harmless and covers the eligibility middleware's bare default), and add one spec per screen stubbing a 401 {code:'NO_SESSION'} asserting the actionable copy renders and is announced. Owner: U6R-FIX (file is inside the community subtree).
findings.clauseImpact: None of the ten briefed clauses fails: 401 is not among the briefed refusal codes, and the rendered fallback is still human. Copy-quality gap only.

observations.summary: Full client suite on this tree: 32 files / 337 tests, 336 pass, 1 FAIL in client/src/features/booking/BookingsListPage.test.jsx:88 (expects link 'Ramen night' with href '/bookings/b2'; getByRole('link',{name:'Ramen night'}) finds none — page stuck at 'Loading your bookings' in the captured DOM). Booking subtree is not this lane's ownership and sibling lanes may have been mid-edit; reported for the booking verifier / U6R-FIX, not counted against community. The community subset re-run in isolation is fully green (3 files / 23 tests).

ReviewPage uploads and attaches photos BEFORE the review POST, so a subsequent 409 (REVIEW_EXISTS / BOOKING_NOT_COMPLETED) leaves already-attached media rows, and a retry mints fresh keys (duplicates). Ownership/lifecycle is server-side (delete-mark + NFR-12 erasure by key), the keys are namespaced to the caller, and no FR-05 clause constrains this ordering — noted only so the wave-7 UX pass knows the trade-off was seen. Sequencing the review POST first is impossible: the schema needs the keys in the body.

MessagesPage's 15 s poll (REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS) satisfies FR-06 'periodic refresh' with aria-live etiquette (announces only genuinely new arrivals, transient poll failures keep the last good view — both pinned by specs). A failed initial load self-heals on the next successful poll. No finding.
